{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id counts: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Confirm the population of interest
print(f'Unique arms: {df["arm"].unique()}')
print(f'Unique severity levels: {df["severity"].unique()}')
print(f'Control arm patients with moderate severity: {df[(df["arm"] == "control") & (df["severity"] == "moderate")].shape[0]}')"}
